simpleBuffGrammar.firstNonemptySlot: exactly one duration marker with positive signed i16 duration
simpleBuffGrammar.remainingNonemptySlots: known positive capID with reviewed mapped stat; signed nonzero i16 operand; no conditions, state commands, repeat, workvalues or unknowns
simpleBuffGrammar.durationUnit: seconds; engine elapsed-time subtraction corroborated by localized item descriptions
simpleBuffGrammar.zeroStatOperands: forbidden: script operand0 refers to current workvalue, not literal0
simpleBuffGrammar.sameGroup: replace previous active item with same duration marker capID
simpleBuffGrammar.activeSelection: a calculator snapshot of active buffs, not item-use scheduling or expiry simulation

subEquipment.katanaElementGate: GetSkillLv(0x56)>0 && GetSkillLv(0x53)>9; not modeled by ordinary stat import

evidence.meaning: Duration classifier list contains209..224 and255; .ctor maps that list through type key1 to DurationBonusType.
When a source line belongs to duration classifier key1, its capID is stored in BonusData+0x44; verified getter names that field DurationBonusType.
209..224 and255 register the same delegate MethodInfo operand; ordinary positive cap ranges register another shared delegate.
Copies capID to BonusScriptData.Type+0x30 and signed i16 operand to duration integer+0x48 and remaining float+0x4c.
Subtracts elapsed engine time from remaining duration; catalog examples corroborate1800=30min and900=15min.
Nonzero signed i16 is passed to AddBonus without display scaling; zero instead loads script workvalue+0x6c.
Unified usable-item path reads BonusLines, CreateBonus(exec=1), then nonzero active duration goes to SetDurationBonus; no ItemType-specific buff branch here.
Dictionary keyed by DurationBonusType adds a new group or removes the prior active entry and replaces the same key.
Sub15/16 clear bonus;sub10 filters through whitelist{65};sub8 clears unless skill0x56>0 and0x53>9 then whitelist{65};other sub types take ordinary bonus route.
Installs ordinary bonus data for the selected EquipType; base attack, refinement and stability are separate status inputs.

limitations: Only conservative static nonzero stat scripts are project-usable. Healing, repeat, status prevention, skill books, warps, unsupported stat conversions and conditional scripts are preserved but not evaluated.
Duration marker names do not constrain which stat follows: runn_hp_heal209 andrunn_mp_heal210 can hold pure stat buffs and are grouped by marker, not by stat key.
Localized prose can disagree with cap operands; no gameplay seasonal multiplier or calendar override was inferred.
Exact constructor delegate MethodInfo heap bindings lie outside preserved module and are unavailable; duration classification, time mutator, enums and item text are corroborated static evidence.
No game execution, consumption, client writes or actual combat/equipment-instance verification was performed.
